Fist Virry is a human fighter and a member of the Flaming Fist. She can be found in the streets of the Lower City in Act Three.
“
These sad little citizens actually think we'll let them off the hook if they complain loudly enough. Ha! What dopes.
„
— Virry, on the concerns of the traders whose wine they are confiscating

Involvement

Act Three

Virry is patrolling the streets of Lower City with  Fist Rockbothem and a  Steel Watcher. She and her fellow Fists can be found at the Grey Harbour Docks at X: -171 Y: -102, bullying traders  Rox Flunter and  Cinna Brewcellar and trying to confiscate the wines they brought to the city under the pretense of smuggled goods. Both Fists seem to feel their impunity, being accompanied by an automaton.

After the Steel Watch Foundry is destroyed, Virry remains at the same place, complaining that shaking the civilians down was much easier with a Steel Watcher behind them.  Saer Deelia,  Flaerian and  Yeller Dawg nearby try to reason with the guards, but to no avail.

Idle banter

  • Rox Flunter
    You really want to confiscate my cargo of ice wine?
  • Fist Virry
    You're a little slow, but you get the point eventually. Citizen.
  • Rox Flunter
    But this wine is already paid for, it's due at the Elfsong Tavern!
  • Fist Virry
    If it's already paid for, you lose nothing by delivering it to me instead. Right, citizen?
  • Rox Flunter
    If this was ruby tonic, I'd let you have it.
  • Fist Virry
    If this was ruby tonic, you could keep it.

After the steel watch foundry is destroyed, Flaerian can be found talking to a couple of merchants:

  • Saer Deelia
    I think it's outrageous that Fists should harass people in a nice neighbourhood!
  • Fist Virry
    Formerly nice neighbourhood. Now back off, honey.
  • Flaerian
    I think your methods are somewhat unorthodox, Saer Fist.
  • Fist Virry
    Hard times, citizen. Let's not let them get any harder, eh?
  • Flaerian
    Saer Fist, I think you should reconsider your tactics here. Please.
  • Yeller Dawg
    Yeah, Saer Fist. Show him why you're called Flaming Fists! Hee hee!
  • Fist Virry
    One more word, and you're both getting the end of my nightstick.
